scripts.title: INFINITE JUMP [OPEN SOURCE]
scripts.script:
-- Infinite Double Jumps only
-- Extracted from HD8TBv.lua.txt
-- No GUI, toggles, Linoria controls, or other mod features.

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local MAX_DOUBLE_JUMPS = 676767
local FighterController
local CurrentFighter
local ItemAddedConnection
local ItemRemovedConnection

local function ResolveFighterController()
    if FighterController then
        return FighterController
    end

    local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
    local controllers = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
    local module = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild('FighterController')

    if not module then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, controller = pcall(require, module)
    if not ok or type(controller) ~= 'table' then
        return nil
    end

    FighterController = controller
    return controller
end

local function ResolveLocalFighter()
    local controller = ResolveFighterController()
    if not controller then
        return nil
    end

    if controller.LocalFighter then
        return controller.LocalFighter
    end

    if type(controller.GetFighter) ~= 'function' then
        return nil
    end

    local fighter = controller:GetFighter(LocalPlayer)
    if fighter then
        return fighter
    end

    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        fighter = controller:GetFighter(LocalPlayer.Character)
        if fighter then
            return fighter
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function ApplyInfiniteDoubleJumps(item)
    if type(item) ~= 'table' then
        return
    end

    local info = item.Info
    if type(info) ~= 'table' then
        return
    end

    rawset(info, 'MaxDoubleJumps', MAX_DOUBLE_JUMPS)
end

local function DisconnectFighterSignals()
    if ItemAddedConnection then
        pcall(function()
            ItemAddedConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        ItemAddedConnection = nil
    end

    if ItemRemovedConnection then
        pcall(function()
            ItemRemovedConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        ItemRemovedConnection = nil
    end
end

local function Refresh()
    local fighter = ResolveLocalFighter()
    if not fighter then
        return false
    end

    if fighter ~= CurrentFighter then
        DisconnectFighterSignals()
        CurrentFighter = fighter

        if fighter.ItemAdded and type(fighter.ItemAdded.Connect) == 'function' then
            ItemAddedConnection = fighter.ItemAdded:Connect(function(item)
                ApplyInfiniteDoubleJumps(item)
            end)
        end
    end

    if type(fighter.Items) ~= 'table' then
        return false
    end

    for _, item in pairs(fighter.Items) do
        ApplyInfiniteDoubleJumps(item)
    end

    return true
end

-- Enabled immediately; no UI or toggle is required.
Refresh()

-- Keep it applied when the fighter/items are recreated or changed.
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        pcall(Refresh)
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

scripts.title: teleport made for  loop tp
scripts.script:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Toggle configurations
local loopUp = false
local loopBehind = false

-- Dynamic offsets
local tpDistance = 2  -- Backwards offset (controlled by Left/Right)
local tpHeight = 2    -- Vertical offset (controlled by Up/Down)

-- Targeted Username Blacklist Table
local blacklistedUsers = {
    ["blacklisted_user"] = true,
    ["blacklisted_user2] = true, 
  
}

-- Advanced Check optimized specifically for Roblox Rivals setup
local function getRivalsTeammate()
    local myCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myCharacter then return nil end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            -- 1. MULTIPLE USERNAME BLACKLIST CHECK
            if not blacklistedUsers[player.Name] then
                
                -- 2. Regular Team Checks
                local isTeammate = (player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team) or 
                                   (player:GetAttribute("Team") == LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team"))
                
                if isTeammate then
                    local char = player.Character
                    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    
                    if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root.Position.Y > -100 then
                        return root
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Continuous frame loop using safe interpolation (Anti-Rubberband)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not loopUp and not loopBehind then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local targetRoot = getRivalsTeammate()
    if not targetRoot then return end

    local destinationCFrame
    if loopUp then
        destinationCFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, tpHeight, 0)
    elseif loopBehind then
        destinationCFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, tpHeight, tpDistance)
    end

    if destinationCFrame then
        myRoot.CFrame = myRoot.CFrame:Lerp(destinationCFrame, 0.45)
    end
end)

-- Keybind Processing
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    local isArrowKey = input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up or 
                       input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down or 
                       input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Left or 
                       input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Right
                       
    if gameProcessed and not isArrowKey then return end
    
    -- Toggles
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K then
        loopUp = not loopUp
        loopBehind = false
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
        loopBehind = not loopBehind
        loopUp = false
        
    -- Horizontal Distance Adjustments
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Right then
        tpDistance = tpDistance + 1
        print("Horizontal distance increased to: " .. tpDistance)
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Left then
        tpDistance = math.max(1, tpDistance - 1)
        print("Horizontal distance decreased to: " .. tpDistance)
        
    -- Vertical Height Adjustments
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
        tpHeight = tpHeight + 1
        print("Vertical height increased to: " .. tpHeight)
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
        tpHeight = tpHeight - 1
        print("Vertical height adjusted to: " .. tpHeight)
    end
end)
